items.html:
A lively medium pacer and a hard hitting batsman who started his
international career with the 1983 Word Cup. He made a marvellous 77, a then
World record, in a match saving partnership of 144 with Imran Khan against
Sri Lanka. Played his one and only test match against India in 1989, when on an
unsupporting pitch for bowlers could not prove his mettle.
( Contributed by Umair Tariq and Abdul Rehman BSc. Class of 2001,
goodguy@deathsdoor.com)
